evals.prompt: I just published my shadcn registry at https://motionkit.dev/r. It has three animation component presets. I want to get listed in the official shadcn directory, registry.directory, the awesome lists, and shadcntemplates. I also need social posts. Can you handle the full launch?
evals.expected_output: Collects the registry profile, runs validate-registry.sh, prepares submissions for all five targets, presents each pull request for approval, and drafts separate posts for Reddit, X, Dev.to, and Hacker News.

evals.prompt: Hey, my scope is @chartblocks and the site is https://chartblocks.io. I only want the official shadcn-ui/ui directory and registry.directory. I don't need the awesome lists or social posts. What do I need to prepare?

evals.prompt: My registry @iconhive merged into the official shadcn directory last week. Now I want announcement drafts for Reddit r/shadcn, X, Dev.to, and Hacker News. The registry is at https://iconhive.dev/r.
